claim_tested: The Cys at the LRAT nucleophile position is required for acyl transfer and serine cannot replace it
key_finding: C161A and C168A activities are virtually nil; C161S possesses only a few percent of wild-type LRAT activity; LRAT is a thiol acyltransferase
context: human RPE LRAT, recombinant, in vitro
confidence_and_limitations: High for the chemistry. Tests LRAT, not LRATD1.

evidence_type: direct assay (enzyme activity on purified and overexpressed protein)
claim_tested: Cys-containing LRAT-domain proteins are active enzymes
key_finding: PLAAT1 (A-C1) has Ca2+-independent PLA1/PLA2 and acyltransferase activity; all five HRASLS members show similar catalytic properties
context: human, mouse, rat recombinant protein; COS-7 homogenates
confidence_and_limitations: High. Establishes the active comparator set.

claim_tested: Catalysis in this family runs through a covalent thioester on the nucleophilic cysteine
key_finding: HRASLS3-LRAT chimeric enzyme crystallised in a thioester catalytic intermediate state
confidence_and_limitations: High. A thioester intermediate requires a thiol; a serine hydroxyl cannot form one.

evidence_type: review with review-level report of the authors' mutagenesis
claim_tested: The LRATD1 paralog FAM84B also lacks the catalytic cysteine
key_finding: FAM84B conserves H23 and H35 but not C113; deletion of the conserved motif abolishes FAM84B oncogenic activities
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Review-level; no separate primary PMID for the motif deletion was found in Europe PMC.

claim_tested: The LRATD1 LRAT domain keeps the active-site architecture with a serine at the nucleophile position
key_finding: 89 CA pairs superposed at RMSD 1.34 A; Ser212 CB 1.76 A from PLAAT3 Cys113 CB; His143 ND1 to Ser212 OG 3.12 A; His-His dyad 2.86 A; nearest cysteine SG 11.26 A from Ser212 OG
confidence_and_limitations: High for geometry. AlphaFold model; no experimental LRATD1 structure exists.

claim_tested: The cysteine loss is an ancient fixed state, not a human or annotation artefact
key_finding: His143, His155, Cys208 and Ser212 invariant in 16 of 16 vertebrate orthologs spanning 63.0-99.3 percent identity
confidence_and_limitations: High. Orthologs selected by gene name plus organism in UniProt, not a formal orthology reconstruction.

claim_tested: A serine cannot act as an efficient nucleophile in a papain-like cysteine-protease active site
key_finding: SARS 3CLpro C145S retains 40-fold lower activity; triad geometries are inverted between serine and cysteine proteinases; Cys to Ser is used as an inactivating mutation in cathepsin L-like proteinases
context: viral and insect enzymes, ab initio calculations
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate to high. None of these is an LRAT-family enzyme.

key_finding: FAM84A is not expressed in 23 normal tissues except testis; protein localises to the subcellular membrane region limited to the region lacking attachment with neighboring cells; exogenous expression increased cell motility in NIH3T3; phosphorylation of serine 38 was associated with cell morphology
context: human colon cancer tissue and NIH3T3 overexpression
confidence_and_limitations: Low to moderate for function. Overexpression in a heterologous line; no catalytic assay and no domain mutants.

claim_tested: Whether an acyltransferase annotation exists that would need removal
key_finding: Q96KN4 has no catalytic MF; IPR007053, IPR043299 and IPR051496 map to no GO term
confidence_and_limitations: High. Reflects the state at the time of retrieval.

claim_tested: Whether LRATD1 has characterised binding partners that suggest a non-catalytic role
key_finding: HuRI reports binding to MAST1 (Q12774) and CYGB (Q8WWM9); the neurodegeneration interactome reports ATXN10 (Q9UBB4)
confidence_and_limitations: Low. High-throughput screens with no orthogonal validation and no mapping to the LRAT domain.

claim_tested: Whether the vestigial pocket is still under selective constraint
key_finding: Glu213 0.996, Phe215 0.995, Trp144 0.983, His155 0.951, Ser212 0.918 against a LRAT-domain mean of 0.676
confidence_and_limitations: Low to moderate. AlphaMissense is MSA-informed, so it is not independent of the conservation analysis.
